text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now for the climax of the "Muse Audition" 
final evaluation! 
Rounding the fourth corner—they hit the 
final stretch! Still leading the pack is 
Mejiro Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu! Mejiro Ramonu pulls further 
ahead! 
Showing off the majesty of the first 
Triple Tiara winner, she crosses the 
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Following close behind are Cesario, Rhein 
Kraft, Daring Heart, 
and Air Messiah! Neck and neck in a fierce 
battle! What an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Trésss bieeeen!! Ramonu-chan's 
breathtaking beauty! 
Cesario-chan's dignified strength!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Kraft-chan's cheerful cuteness! 
Messiah-chan's 
sincere elegance! Heart-chan's sparkling 
glamour!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of you is the ab-so-lute 
best!! 
This year's "Muses"! It's decided, all 
five of them will take the crown~~!!
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's decide on the concept for the debut 
show!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You girls have made a fateful engagement 
with your racing outfits. 
And the place to unveil that happiness is 
the "Beauty Dream Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Showcasing your beautiful racing outfits 
on stage, and then racing— 
you must pour your own heartfelt feelings 
into such a glorious spotlight♡

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So, I want to hear your imaginations run 
wild☆ 
—By the way! Here's what the dress design 
looks like!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! How beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Doing a show in this... My heart is so 
full, 
I can't even think of a concept off the 
top of my head...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We have no experience with fashion shows, 
after all. 
Just receiving such dresses is already 
overwhelmingly touching...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't feel too pressured while 
brainstorming. 
Your genuine feelings are what matter the 
most☆

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd love to incorporate 
lots of imagery from the Tiara route 
races! For example—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms, oak trees, 
dahlias—decorating with lots of flowers 
themed after the Triple Tiara! I want the 
colors to be bright and gorgeous, too...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... All of this year's Muses are 
Tiara Umamusume, after all. 
Going all-in on the Tiara motif is 
something only we can do this year.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If we're doing it, we should include some 
eye-catching designs, too! 
Like, sprinkling in some slightly 
avant-garde bouquets!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since it's the prestigious Muse stage... 
I'd like to smoothly fuse our unique touch 
this year with past traditions, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mfu♪ Wonderful, that sounds absolutely 
lovely! 
Let's make it a special, beautiful stage 
that's uniquely yours☆

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: And here is your debut stage☆

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The sets are yet to be built, so it's 
empty right now, 
but it's good to get a feel for the 
venue's atmosphere ahead of time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
On such a massive stage...! 
To think that in just three weeks... 
wow...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you nervous, Cesario? 
This is our stage, we have to enjoy it to 
the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you girls are the stars of 
the runway☆ 
Hold your heads high!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Ramonu-chan? 
If you have any requests, please don't 
hesitate to speak up☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I wish to hold a ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A ceremony of vows—dedicated to my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To my darling "beloved"... I wish to 
pledge my vows.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"And so... could you prepare an 
extraordinary stage for me? 
I wish to meet the 'true' them."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"That is all I ask. 
...I leave it in your capable hands."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—It just hit me like a lightning bolt, 
daaaahling!!!! A ceremony of vows!! 
A ceremony to swear your future in 
racing!! Let's do it!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmhuhu! Yes, yes, when it comes to 
unveiling new racewear, 
this is totally the way to go!! What do 
you girls think, Cesario!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um... yes. I think that sounds absolutely 
wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Our future in racing... If that is the 
case, I do have something to swear. 
—In fact, I believe everyone here feels 
the same.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it's settled then! This year's 
"Beauty Dream Cup" 
will be a ceremony of vows dedicated to 
racing!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we'll incorporate your ideas 
into the venue's decor too! 
We'll build an exquisite special chapel 
and turf☆

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The big day is three weeks from now! We're 
crafting the finest dresses for you all, 
so look forward to it, daaaahlings～☆
